# Required shared P4 qualification media

These are owned synthetic stereo pulses generated by
`tools/generate_p4_qualification_fixtures.py`. No third-party audio or database
content is included. `manifest.json` records exact sizes, SHA-256 and the encoder
version. CI uses these committed files and never silently downloads/replaces
them. Regeneration is an explicit reviewed change because encoder output may
differ between versions.

| Fixture | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `onset-44100.wav` | Exact lossless stereo PCM, 6.5 seconds at 44.1 kHz |
| `onset-48000.flac` | Same deterministic waveform at 48 kHz, real FLAC decode |
| `onset-44100.mp3` | Actual VBR/bit-reservoir decode and acoustic seek onset |
| `short-48000.wav` | 80 ms EOF with longer analysis metadata |
| `export.pdb` | DeviceSQL title index 17 and audio path index 20 |
| `ANLZ0000.DAT` | Standard PQTZ phases 1–4 and tagged PCPT Hot Cue A |

WAV/FLAC PCM is compared sample-for-sample against the integer signal formula,
including the final partial batch. The engine is tested after seeks at 1.2,
4.2 and 6.2 seconds. MP3 seek onset is compared to the same file's full decoded
PCM source clock, preserving immutable encoder/Xing delay. The relative error
bound is 96 frames; WAV/FLAC allow one frame. MP3 trim/gapless support is not
inferred from this test. Deck position/BPM telemetry is not its oracle.

The tests use the production decoder and frame-index/seek modules. The PC-only
PCM observation hook neither rewinds nor substitutes a decoder. Full-track WAV
export intentionally rewinds and is tested separately. Loop/preroll, LOAD/PLAY
reservation, cue hold/handoff and jog-mode regressions remain in their production
module suites. The 300-second dual-deck MT soak is a separate DSP gate.

Run the complete software host gate with:

```powershell
$env:Path = "$env:Path;C:\msys64\ucrt64\bin"
.\tests\run_p4_host_tests.ps1 -Qualification
```

Qualification rejects selected-suite mode, missing signing tooling, a skipped
required media case, missing fixtures or changed hashes. Passing software
qualification does not establish installed-image, acoustic or physical acceptance.
